commit 529a6e5bdd17a6cd2eba02463c79423bbba91665
Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
AuthorDate: Wed Jul 29 04:58:17 2026 +0000
Commit:     geoff@darktrojan.net <geoff@darktrojan.net>
CommitDate: Wed Jul 29 05:00:19 2026 +0000

    Bug 2058787 - Port bug 2055645: add git support in landoscript's tag action.
    
    Just the default "{head_rev}" for now, if we need more later we can change it.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D314829

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-early-tagging/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-early-tagging/kind.yml
index 1f75f41a60d..cfd19229f47 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/release-early-tagging/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/release-early-tagging/kind.yml
@@ -5,6 +5,7 @@
 loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader
 
 transforms:
+    - taskgraph.transforms.task_context
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_deps:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.resolve_landoscript_keyed_by:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms
@@ -14,6 +15,11 @@ task-defaults:
     description: Release Promotion version tag for buildN
     run-on-projects: []
     shipping-phase: promote
+    task-context:
+        from-parameters:
+            head_rev: head_rev
+        substitution-fields:
+            - worker.actions
     worker-type: lando
     worker:
         implementation: scriptworker-lando
@@ -33,6 +39,7 @@ task-defaults:
         actions:
             - tag:
                   types: ["buildN"]
+                  revision: "{head_rev}"
 
                   # Used to map hg revisions to the git revisions that scriptworker-lando needs
                   hg-repo-url:
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-version-bump/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-version-bump/kind.yml
index c0d7a49d7ea..508a987621e 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/release-version-bump/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/release-version-bump/kind.yml
@@ -5,6 +5,7 @@
 loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader
 
 transforms:
+    - taskgraph.transforms.task_context
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_deps:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.resolve_landoscript_keyed_by:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms
@@ -17,6 +18,11 @@ task-defaults:
     description: Release Promotion version bump/tag
     run-on-projects: []
     shipping-phase: ship
+    task-context:
+        from-parameters:
+            head_rev: head_rev
+        substitution-fields:
+            - worker.actions
     worker-type: lando
     worker:
         implementation: scriptworker-lando
@@ -36,6 +42,7 @@ task-defaults:
         actions:
             - tag:
                   types: ["release"]
+                  revision: "{head_rev}"
 
                   # Used to map hg revisions to the git revisions needed by scriptworker-lando
                   hg-repo-url:
title: Bug 2058787 - Port bug 2055645: add git support in landoscript's tag action.
